summary: qlik-chart-modules preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares preinstall `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is heavily obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifiers and string-array dictionary aliases) and, when `bun` is not on PATH, downloads the Bun runtime zip from GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` to run the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a single-line ~727KB opaque blob using an index-rotated string array (obfuscator.io shape), executed under the freshly downloaded alien runtime on every `npm install`. The package presents itself as Qlik chart tooling and lists `QlikTech International AB` as author, but a genuine Qlik utility library has no need to fetch a second language runtime at install time or execute a large obfuscated sibling payload; the shipped install-time behavior is inconsistent with the advertised purpose and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern in which the fetched runtime is used to run bundled obfuscated code whose behavior cannot be inspected from source. Installing this package runs the obfuscated payload on the installer's host at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
